entries.zh: 單行、縱列；一行（行列次序）
entries.en: a single row/line; single file; their order
entries.notes: L 首字疑為 renglón（行、列）之形誤；H 獨行 按「單行、行列」解，R 欄空。

entries.zh: 前來叫罵、斥責、爭鬥（罵、斥、闘）
entries.en: to come scolding, rebuking, and fighting
entries.notes: M 欄兩處 T99 污損，R 欄 por ham polichi 難解，僅按 H 罵斥闘 與 L「venir a pelear」立意。

entries.en: to come habitually, to come as a matter of course
entries.notes: H 贅（chè）與 L「venir ordinariamente」語義不密合，或為借字，存疑。

entries.en: to come contending/arguing, to come insisting
to come and put/place (something); to set down
entries.notes: L「poner de manda~」之 ~ 為縮寫且語意不明，暫按 放＝放置 立意。

entries.en: to twist/wring clothing; to come twisting one's garments
entries.notes: L「abiendo se de la ropa」殘損費解，僅就 扭＋衣物 推測。

entries.zh: 動手拉扯、扭打起來（前來交手）
entries.en: to come to blows; to grapple and pull at each other
entries.notes: R 欄 lo bâ ayarrase dos glean do [残] 殘損，然大意為拉扯，與 扯 相應。

entries.en: to quarrel; to scold one another
entries.notes: L 與 H 均劃線勾銷，係編者刪除之條，釋義仍可辨。
H 炒齒 字面費解（疑為 吵起／吵嘴 之借字），L 僅作 venir，難定。

entries.en: to bully and coerce; to oppress
entries.notes: R 欄 apauuar. 字跡難解（或為 apalear 毆打之誤寫），L 僅作 venir。

entries.zh: 以言語觸犯、頂撞他（原字費解）
entries.en: to offend/provoke him with words (reading uncertain)
entries.notes: H 馨觸伊 與 M guiygo tay y 難以對合，R 僅存 iy（伊），存疑。

entries.zh: 嘴硬、口頭強硬（不肯服軟）
entries.en: hard-mouthed; stubborn in speech, unwilling to give in
entries.notes: L 僅作 venir、R 欄 ios 難解，依 H 口硬 與 M chùi nge 立意。
L 僅作 venir，R 欄 ios 不明；H 誹罵 與 M hui mie 相符。

entries.en: to obstruct; to block and delay
entries.notes: L 僅作 venir，R 欄 ios 不明；H 阻滯 與 M chou ty 相符。

entries.zh: 口角、言語爭執（動口不動手）
entries.en: to come to words; to have a war of words
entries.notes: R 欄此行實作西語 por palabra，與 L 互證。

entries.en: to argue stubbornly without cause; to come quarreling unreasonably
